external_sources.title: VWAP-Based Regime Classification Model for Intraday Price Dynamics
external_sources.claim: Volatility-normalized VWAP deviation can distinguish trend-dominated from mean-reverting intraday environments, supporting state-conditioned rather than unconditional reversion.

external_sources.title: Order Flow and Cryptocurrency Returns
external_sources.claim: Cryptocurrency order flow contains predictive information for returns; persistent directional flow is therefore a causal reason to delay/forbid fading a VWAP deviation.

external_sources.title: Equilibrium Effects of Intraday Order-Splitting Benchmarks
external_sources.claim: VWAP/TWAP benchmark trading creates predictable intraday price pressure and affects liquidity/volatility, so benchmark-driven flow can make apparent VWAP dislocations persist instead of revert immediately.

external_sources.title: Volume Profile Mean Reversion Strategy with Tape Speed Confirmation for Cryptocurrency Futures Markets
external_sources.claim: A crypto-futures mean-reversion study explicitly conditions entries on tape-speed confirmation and finds transaction costs can dominate tight-stop specifications, supporting confirmation and cost-aware falsification.

top3_axes.mechanism: Keep frozen VWAP deviation and exits unchanged; permit reversion intent only after a preregistered entry-time-observable directional order-flow/tape-speed exhaustion or sign-reversal event confirms that the flow causing the deviation is no longer persisting.
top3_axes.falsification: At a fresh prospective boundary, flow-exhaustion-confirmed trades fail to improve gross/net expectancy and PF versus frozen baseline and a direction-permuted flow control, or gains come only from destructive trade deletion.

top3_axes.mechanism: Keep entry deviation logic unchanged but allow it only in one preregistered volatility-normalized non-trending VWAP regime; explicitly no-trade in trend-dominated regimes.
top3_axes.falsification: Fresh regime-conditioned trades do not outperform a frozen regime-permutation placebo on gross/net expectancy and PF, or retention/sample becomes insufficient.

top3_axes.mechanism: Keep VWAP reversion mechanics unchanged; preregister a single no-fade state when entry-time evidence indicates persistent benchmark/order-splitting pressure likely to maintain the VWAP displacement.
top3_axes.falsification: Fresh no-fade conditioning fails to improve gross/net expectancy or only removes losing time windows without a mechanism-consistent control benefit.
